subject.title: fix: keep queued approval prompts visible

question: Should this draft remain the canonical landing path for the queued Control UI approval fix, or should maintainers consolidate it into another candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99281?
rationale: Both candidate PRs are open and conflicting, this draft is assigned to steipete, and current main has moved the affected code while already covering part of the reconnect-refresh behavior.

options.title: Finish this draft as canonical
options.body: Ask for or make a rebase that ports the modal/button/regression coverage to the current UI paths, drops redundant reconnect refresh if current main already covers it, and attaches browser proof.

options.title: Consolidate into the newer PR
options.body: Close this draft only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99281 is rebased, proof-positive, and clearly owns the canonical issue.

options.title: Maintainer ports directly
options.body: A maintainer can land a narrow main-branch fix and then close both external candidate PRs with the implemented commit as provenance.

recommendation.title: Finish this draft as canonical
recommendation.body: Ask for or make a rebase that ports the modal/button/regression coverage to the current UI paths, drops redundant reconnect refresh if current main already covers it, and attaches browser proof.
